title: PackageManifest
description: Generated file included in every packaged skill artifact (manifest.json). Created by skpm during packaging. Describes the artifact contents, provenance, and metadata snapshot. This file must not be authored manually.

spec_version.description: Package manifest format version. Must be 1 for this schema.

version.description: Exact SemVer version. Must match skill.yaml and the VERSION file.

sha256.description: SHA256 digest of the complete artifact archive in lowercase hexadecimal. This value is set by the packaging tool after the archive is sealed and matches the digest registered with the registry.

files.description: Lexicographically sorted list of all files included in the archive, relative to the archive root. manifest.json and checksums.txt are included.

packaged_by.description: Tool and version that produced this artifact. Omit for reproducible builds where tool identity must not affect the archive.

packaged_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the artifact was produced. Omit for reproducible builds where timestamps must not affect the archive.

source_commit.description: Git commit SHA of the skill source at package time, if available.

compatible_with.description: Agent platforms declared as compatible. Copied from skill.yaml at package time.

entrypoint.description: Relative path to the agent-readable entrypoint within the archive. Copied from skill.yaml.

license.description: SPDX license expression. Copied from skill.yaml.

signature.description: Cryptographic signature over the artifact SHA256, if produced by the packaging toolchain.

provenance.description: URI to a SLSA or equivalent provenance attestation, if available.

metadata.description: Freeform extension metadata. Not validated beyond being an object.
